LanguageData.RDL_SwitchDesc_ToSirim:
Click to switch to [Sirim Logic Mode].

Current: [Rimi]
Style: Cheerful, cute, emotional.
Best for: Chatting, comfort, emotional support.
LanguageData.RDL_SwitchDesc_ToRimi:
Click to switch to [Rimi Emotional Mode].

Current: [Sirim]
Style: Cold, efficient, data-driven.
Best for: Analysis, survival tips, combat tactics.
LanguageData.RDL_AskDesc_Rimi: Ask Rimi for comfort or a chat.\n(e.g., Feeling lonely, bad mood, or just want a joke)
LanguageData.RDL_AskDesc_Sirim: Request a situational analysis from Sirim.\n(e.g., Temperature, health status, or tactical advice)
LanguageData.RDL_Settings_StrictDesc: Work is forcibly interrupted and the pawn is stunned for 2s when caught.
LanguageData.RDL_Settings_PenaltyDesc: Global work speed reduced by 5% when carrying digital devices.
LanguageData.RDL_Settings_EnableAssistantDesc: When disabled, pawns will not trigger Rimi/Sirim conversations automatically or manually.
LanguageData.RDL_Settings_ReminderSub: Reminding the player in front of the screen to rest and stay healthy
LanguageData.RDL_Settings_EyeEnableDesc: Periodically reminds you to rest your eyes and look into the distance.
LanguageData.RDL_Settings_WaterEnableDesc: Periodically reminds you to drink a glass of water.
LanguageData.RDL_Settings_LateNightEnableDesc: Reminds you to rest during late night hours.
LanguageData.RDL_Settings_UseDialogDesc: Show reminders in a popup dialog (more noticeable). Uncheck to use the message sidebar instead.
LanguageData.RDL_Settings_PauseGameDesc: Automatically pause the game when a reminder pops up.
LanguageData.RDL_Reminder_Eye_Message: You've been playing for a while. Time to rest your eyes!\nTip: Look at something distant or close your eyes for a few minutes.
LanguageData.RDL_Reminder_Water_Message: Time to drink some water!\nStand up, stretch, and stay hydrated.
LanguageData.RDL_Reminder_LateNight_Message: It's already {0} - pretty late!\nTake care of yourself and get some rest. The colony will still be here tomorrow!
LanguageData.RDL_Reminder_Footer: This reminder is brought to you by Uncle @MaiyaMaiya's Rim Digital Life mod. You can adjust the interval and toggle this feature in Mod Settings. Apologies for any inconvenience.
